configuration.checkpoint_file: unavailable through ModelView; actual module state hashed instead
configuration.cleaning: HTML unescape; remove tags; Unicode NFKC; lowercase; collapse whitespace; retain accents
configuration.lexical_fill: positive-cosine top 99, ID tie break; uniform remaining eligible IDs
configuration.lexical_query: normalized mean of visible occurrence vectors; target query is oracle-conditioned
configuration.mapping: ModelView metadata keys and histories must already use mapped item IDs 1..itemnum
configuration.seed_scheme: SeedSequence([42, category_index, sorted_user_index, target_position, condition_index, draw_index])
configuration.tie_order: score descending, mapped item ID ascending; host equivalence unverified
configuration.weighted_algorithm: exponential race with rates count**0.75; increasing arrival order is successive weighted sampling without replacement; uniform fill only after positive rates are exhausted

four_category_macro.reason: one category ModelView per invocation; requires all four user-level audit outputs
